title: Tidal migration row
description: One parent-satellite pair's tidal-dissipation-driven secular orbital migration (the v0.21.6 sixth cross-channel coupling surface). The signed migration rate is positive=outward, negative=inward, zero=locked. Required fields are the ones every row shares (pair_name, parent_body, satellite_body, migration_rate_cm_per_year, migration_direction, source_doi, source_published_date, entered_locally_at).

parent_body.description: Parent body name (the body being orbited).

satellite_body.description: Satellite body name (the orbiting body whose semi-major axis drifts).

migration_rate_cm_per_year.description: Secular migration rate in cm/year. Signed: positive = outward, negative = inward, zero = locked/synchronous.

migration_direction.description: Verbatim direction label. outward = satellite gaining orbital energy; inward = losing it (tidal-disruption bound); locked = tidal end-state, no migration.

is_resonance_locked.description: True if the pair is in observed mean-motion resonance with at least one other body (e.g., Io in the Galilean Laplace 1:2:4 resonance).

additional_constraint.description: Free-text constraint (resonance partners, tidal-disruption deadline, end-state characterisation).

precision_flag.description: Ship-readiness precision flag (the measurement's observational quality).

source_key.description: Short citation key into the module SOURCES dict (e.g., 'williams_2014', 'lainey_2020_migration'). Redundant with source_doi; retained for cross-linking to the module's full citation string.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper authorising this row's migration rate. Required by the literature_curated adapter for per-row attestation. Triality-attested against live CrossRef.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 date the cited paper was published. 'YYYY', 'YYYY-MM', or 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Curator-authored from the cited DOI's CrossRef metadata; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:issued. For williams this is 2015 (CrossRef published year), not the 2014 DOI-suffix submission convention.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date this row was first added or last meaningfully amended. Curator-authored; aligns with Dublin Core dcterms:dateAccessioned.

source_version.description: Optional version/edition tag where it matters; null for journal papers whose DOI fully resolves the version.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — direction rationale, resonance context, disruption-deadline timescale, cross-references to the v0.21.4 Q-factor or v0.21.8 heat-flow surfaces.
